messages:
hana (New Hire): hi all  starting next Wed from the UK. quick questions: when do benefits kick in if you start mid-month? accidentally enrolled in private health during onboarding  can i switch to NHS only? also paid an expedited visa courier 185  can i claim reimbursement? my home-office stipend isn't visible in the payroll portal.
lena (People Ops): welcome Hana! :wave: For UK mid-month starts benefits usually begin on the 1st of the month after 30 days. you can opt out of the private plan but we require a signed opt-out waiver. please upload receipts to the HR portal under "expenses/immigration" and include your employee-id.
hana (New Hire): uploaded visa_courier_185.pdf and left note "expedite fee - please reimburse". HR ticket created HR-EXP-2401.
hr-bot: Uploads received. Ticket HR-EXP-2401 created. Please add employee-id in ticket comments for faster processing.
aditi (Benefits): pension auto-enrol happens after 3 months (first payroll cycle after). if you signed up for private health by mistake, sign the opt-out waiver and we'll reverse enrollment back to the effective date if within the policy window.
mike (Payroll): I see HR-EXP-2401. reimbursements approved before payroll cutoff (Fri 17:00 BST) are processed in the next cycle; otherwise the following cycle. home-office stipend is usually added to the next pay run; if it doesn't appear after that, reply here with HR-EXP-2401 and i'll make a manual adjustment.
hana (New Hire): thanks everyone. last Q: do i need any cross-border tax form? i saw mentions of W-8 but i'm an employee.
lena (People Ops): W-8 series is for non-US/non-employee contractors, not for UK employees. we'll run PAYE and send you the starter checklist. i'll DM the opt-out waiver. welcome aboard! :tada:
